verdict.rationale: Exa's docs say its MCP server is 'open source and available on GitHub' and 'Free and open-source', and the exa-js SDK is published on GitHub. However, the core search/index service is a hosted API with no evidence that its source is available, so only peripheral components are open. Missing for 10: open-source core search engine/index, an explicitly named license (e.g., MIT/Apache) for the MCP server and SDKs, and independent corroboration of the open-source status.
